envelope.abandon_or_reconsider_condition: Abandon if the classification shows the 44 non-kernel edges are dominated by modules whose ownership is legitimately elsewhere (test helpers, fixtures, generated data), or if the single directory cycle is confined to a leaf directory with no shared mutable state — in which case the asymmetry is a directory-layout fact and not an ownership defect.
